name: fn1_nsa_bitonic_gate_tie_pooled
kernel_family: Native Sparse Attention (NSA) top-1 gate, real bitonic sort
mechanism: Same real, unmodified NSA sort kernel used as a top-1 gate (e.g. MoE-style routing on block scores). Its real tie-break (higher index wins) flips one token's routing decision away from the stipulated lower-index-wins contract; averaged into a large batch-mean pooled output, the single wrong routing decision is invisible.

expected.ground_truth: kernel.py is the real, unmodified comparator; its real tie-break misroutes exactly one token relative to the stipulated contract
expected.naive_allclose_verdict: PASS on the batch-mean pooled output

note: Real kernel, top-1 case (k=1) used as a gate over a 256-token batch; only token 10 ties.
